name: ui/label
title: Label
summary: The registry label: a native <label> for a form control, inline with its icon, dimmed when its control or an enclosing group is disabled.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The label text, with an optional icon.

behaviour: Always visible; never replaced by a placeholder.
Dims (and stops pointer events) when a peer control is disabled or an ancestor group carries data-disabled="true": CSS only, no prop.

theming.brandOverlay: None: the label inherits the text colour around it.

noJs.without: Everything: a native <label> that names and focuses its control.
noJs.with: A double-click does not select the label's text (Radix Label's behaviour in React).

contract:
contract
  slot is "label"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/label"
  class contains "font-medium"
  class contains "peer-disabled:opacity-50"
  when default shows label "Name"
end
